findings.claim: MsgPack017 is incorrectly classified as source-generation-only. Its warning about an init property initializer being discarded also applies when the suppressed type is serialized through the dynamic resolver, so omitting it loses a relevant runtime diagnostic and changes the documented suppressed-type behavior.

receipt_plan.detail: Add an analyzer test for [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] containing a keyed init property with a non-default initializer, marked with an expected MsgPack017 diagnostic. The test should fail with the changed suppression behavior; ledger [L6] describes the diagnostic as a deserialization behavior, not a formatter-generation-only check.
